description: Defines macros, structures, and inline functions for implementing linked lists, including list initialization, traversal, addition, deletion, and safety mechanisms.

methods.name: list_empty
methods.description: Checks if a list is empty.

methods.name: __list_add
methods.description: Internal function to insert a new list element between two known elements.

methods.name: list_add_tail
methods.description: Adds a new element at the tail of the list.

methods.name: __list_del
methods.description: Internal function to remove a list element by relinking neighbors.

methods.name: list_del
methods.description: Removes an element from the list and poisons its pointers.
